title: Greetings from Wales … Unbelievable turn of events

body: Would you believe that when I arrived in the UK I was informed that I had been invited as a special guest to the royal wedding? That it turns out the Duke and Duchess are big fans of my books and sent a limousine to bring me when they heard via Facebook that I was in the UK? That they even provided a rental tuxedo when i explained I didn’t bring any dress clothes? That I sat in the seventh row for the wedding and was a special guest at the luncheon for friends and family? No, I didn’t think so. Actually, I’m in Wales and speaking at a conference full of wonderful people … will be here through the weekend, then on to Derbyshire and then to Amsterdam.
